categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Only touches src/wallet/test/*; category explicitly excludes labeled PRs whose tests are about a single area.
categories.rationale: Excluded from test infrastructure because the category definition specifies that PRs whose tests are about one area go to that area instead.

categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Modifies wallet unit test suites and wallet test utilities across src/wallet/test/*.
categories.rationale: Reduces wallet unit test execution times by configuring mock descriptor wallets with a minimal keypool size of 1 instead of 1000. Author benchmarks confirmed by reviewers show coinselector_tests dropping from 8.26 s to 3.35 s, spend_tests from 0.59 s to 0.18 s, and group_outputs_tests from 0.33 s to 0.12 s.
